newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tobishima says many creditors positive on plan.
newsitem.headline: Tobishima says many creditors positive on plan.

text.p: Tobishima Corp said on Wednesday that many of its creditor financial institutions were moving towards acceptance of its restructuring plan.

But a company spokesman declined to comment specifically on a report by the Nihon Keizai Shimbun business daily on Wednesday that they had already agreed to accept the construction firm's restructuring plan.
"We believe that many of our creditors are moving towards accepting the plan. But we cannot comment on the report," the Tobishima spokesman said.

Debt-ridden Tobishima formed the restructuring plan last year under which it asked its creditors to reduce their claims against the construction firm for its group companies' debt to 100 billion yen from about 740 billion yen.
There are more than 50 creditor financial institutions, of which Fuji Bank Ltd is the main creditor.
